mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.buyer_id, buyer.username AS buyer_name, o.buyer_phone, buyer.buyer_rating_score AS buyer_rating_score, o.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_name, o.seller_phone, seller.seller_rating_score AS seller_rating_score, o.book_id, o.book_title, o.book_cover, o.original_price, o.price, o.trade_type, o.meet_location, o.meet_time, o.remark, o.cancel_reason, o.status, o.buyer_confirmed, o.seller_confirmed, o.buyer_reviewed, o.seller_reviewed, o.created_at, o.confirmed_at, o.buyer_confirmed_at, o.seller_confirmed_at, o.completed_at, o.cancelled_at FROM book_order o LEFT JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id LEFT JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.buyer_id, buyer.username AS buyer_name, o.buyer_phone, o.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_name, o.seller_phone, o.book_id, o.book_title, o.book_cover, o.original_price, o.price, o.trade_type, o.meet_location, o.meet_time, o.remark, o.cancel_reason, o.status, o.buyer_confirmed, o.seller_confirmed, o.buyer_reviewed, o.seller_reviewed, o.created_at, o.confirmed_at, o.buyer_confirmed_at, o.seller_confirmed_at, o.completed_at, o.cancelled_at FROM book_order o LEFT JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id LEFT JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{userId} OR o.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
